sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

reply.text:
Dear customer,

We are following up on our previous offer of €5.40 per unit, as we have not yet received your feedback. 

Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide on how you would like to proceed. 

To recap the details, our offer stands at a price of €5.40 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please keep in mind that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

As your trusted distributor, we always strive to provide you with the best service and support. Please let us know if you require any further information to proceed with the proposed terms. We look forward to hearing from you soon!

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Dear customer,

As we have not received a response to our final offer, we assume your requirements have been met elsewhere. We are therefore closing this negotiation and withdrawing our offer. 

Our offer stays valid for 14 days. We thank you for your interest and remain at your disposal for future inquiries.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels) [n18101] (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (werdenfels).
Our order history for this part shows 5.26 EUR (po:4500013373-10) against 5.84 EUR in the latest order (po:4500014427-10).
Our volume forecast for this part is up 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).
Your on-time delivery was 81.0% (sc:70740@2026Q3).
Today you supply 20 % of our need for this part, another approved source the rest. A binding 24-month commitment on these terms puts you first in line for a larger share.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 23,700 kg per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We welcome the 24-month contract and the inclusion of the AS-14404 index clause as proposed in your first package.
Taking your historical order prices into account, we have reduced our offer to €5.50 per unit.
Please understand that we cannot provide a detailed cost breakdown, as this information is proprietary.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We can accept your proposed 36-month contract and 60-day payment terms, provided we maintain the AS-14404 index clause, as we cannot offer fixed prices.
In exchange for the extended contract duration, we have reduced our price to €5.40 per unit.
Please also provide the underlying forecast data to support your stated volume commitment of 23,700 kg per year.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
